name: Milena Petrović
bio:
Milena Petrović's journey in motorsport began with a childhood fascination for Formula One, watching races with her father and dissecting the technical intricacies of each car. She pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in aerodynamics, and quickly rose through the ranks at a smaller racing outfit. Her keen eye for talent and strategic decision-making earned her a reputation as a rising star. 

Milena is known for her meticulous approach to team management, fostering a collaborative environment where every member feels valued and empowered. She believes in data-driven decision-making, leveraging advanced analytics to optimize performance both on and off the track. Her innovative spirit and relentless pursuit of excellence have made her a valuable asset to Red Bull Racing, where she aims to build a championship-winning team. Her ability to foster a positive and productive work environment, even under immense pressure, sets her apart from many of her peers.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, sleek, often pulled back in a low ponytail
physical.description: Milena has a sharp, intelligent look, framed by her dark hair and intense brown eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas, even during meetings.
Insists on having a specific brand of Serbian coffee brewed every morning.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
